notablePrerequisites: Salvaging Station does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it returning the {0} cost artifact from your graveyard to the battlefield.
The artifact enters the battlefield as a creature due to March of the Machines, and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Salvaging Station triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.
